paragraphs.source_en: When the master heard the word “uncle,” he seemed suddenly to remember something and asked Meitei, “This is the first I’ve ever heard that you have an uncle. You’ve never mentioned him before! Do you really have such an uncle?” Meitei looked as though he had been waiting eagerly for the master to ask just that. He said, “Yes, that uncle of mine. That uncle is a tremendous old diehard; he has gone on living without interruption from the nineteenth century right down to this twentieth-century present.” As he said this, he looked first at the master and then at the master’s wife. The master’s wife said with a smiling laugh, “You do say the most amusing things! And where does your venerable uncle live?” “He lives in Shizuoka, but he is not merely still alive; he is alive with a topknot still perched on his head, which is truly enough to command admiration. I say to him, ‘Please wear a hat.’ He declares proudly, ‘I have lived to this age and have never yet felt so cold that I needed to wear a hat.’ Sometimes I say, ‘It is terribly cold; you should stay in bed a little longer.’ But he says, ‘For a human being, four hours of sleep is enough. To sleep more than four hours is nothing short of luxury.’ He is always up before daybreak. And then he boasts, ‘In order to reduce my sleeping time to four hours, I trained myself for many years. When I was young I was terribly sleepy, but only recently have I entered the state where I can do just as I please, and nothing could delight me more.’ He is sixty-seven already, so of course he sleeps less; that goes without saying, and it has nothing whatever to do with training or self-cultivation. Yet he himself believes it is entirely the result of his own self-discipline. Also, whenever he goes out, he is sure to take an iron fan with him.” The master asked, “What does he use it for?” “I don’t know what he uses it for. At any rate, whenever he goes out he takes it along. Perhaps he thinks of that iron fan as a sort of walking stick. But the other day something strange happened.” This time Meitei deliberately addressed the master’s wife. The master’s wife answered with a neutral, noncommittal, “What strange thing?” “This spring he suddenly sent me a letter telling me to send him a top hat and a frock coat at once. I was somewhat bewildered, so I wrote back and asked about it; the reply said that the old gentleman intended to wear them himself. There was to be a victory celebration in Shizuoka on the twenty-third, and he ordered me to buy them and send them before then without fail. What was still funnier was that his order put it this way: as for the hat, buy one of about the right size; as for the Western suit, estimate the measurements and have it made at the Daimaru kimono shop.” “Does Daimaru make Western clothes nowadays?” the master asked. Meitei said, “No, my dear fellow; he had mistaken Shirokiya for Daimaru.” The master asked again, “Isn’t it impossible to have a suit made for him just by estimating the measurements?” Meitei said, “That is precisely what makes my uncle my uncle!” The master asked, “Then what did you do?” Meitei said, “What could I do? I simply estimated the measurements, had a suit made, and sent it to him.”

paragraphs.source_zh: 主人听了“伯父”的字样，好像突然想起来似的，问迷亭说：“今天我才头一次听说你有个伯父：你过去从来没有讲过呀！你真有这样的伯父吗？”迷亭好像巴不得等主人这么提问呢。他说道：“唔，我的伯父，我这个伯父可是个老顽固哪，他从十九世纪一直没完没了地活到二十世纪的今天哩。”说着，他瞧瞧主人，又瞧瞧主人的妻子。主人的妻子笑吟吟地说道：“您净说些有趣的话！您的伯父他老人家住在哪儿呀？”“住在静冈，不过他可不只是还活着，而且脑袋上还一直顶着个顶髻哪，真让人不能不为之赞叹啊。我对他说：‘您戴顶帽子吧。’他骄傲地说：‘我活了这么大年纪，还从来没有感到怕冷需要戴帽子。’我有时说：‘太冷了，您再多躺一会儿吧。’可是他说：‘人嘛，睡上四个小时就够啦，如果超过四个小时，那简直就是一种奢侈。’他总是天不亮就起床。而且，他还得意地说：‘我为了把睡眠时间缩短到四小时，做过长期的锻炼，年轻的时候也是困得很，只是到了最近我才进入随心所欲的境地，再也没有比这更使人高兴的了。’他已经六十七岁，当然睡眠少，这还用说嘛，才不是什么修养锻炼的功夫哩。可他本人却自以为完全是靠克己的功夫取得的。还有，在他出门的时候，一定要带把铁扇哩。”主人问道：“带上它做什么用？”“我不知道用场，反正他出门总要带上，也许他想用这柄铁扇代替手杖吧。可是，前一些日子却发生了一件怪事。”这次，迷亭是有意和主人的妻子搭话。主人的妻子不痛不痒地回答了一声：“什么怪事？”“就是今年春天他突然来了一封信，信中让我立刻给他老人家寄一顶大礼帽和一件大礼服去。我有点莫名其妙，写信去问了一下，回信说是老人家自己要穿的。二十三日在静冈有个祝捷会庆，命令我必须在此之前买好寄去。更可笑的是，他老人家的命令是这样说的：帽子嘛，可买个差不多大小的，西装嘛，也估量一下尺寸，到大丸和服店订做去。”“近来大丸也做西装了吗？”主人问。迷亭说：“哪里，老兄，他是将白木屋错当成大丸啦。”主人又问：“让你估量尺寸给他做西装，这能行吗？”迷亭说：“这就是我伯父之所以为伯父的地方呀！”主人问道：“那么你怎么办的？”迷亭说：“有什么办法，只好估量着做了一套给他寄去。”
